overview: At the lodging, while the company played The Shrew, you wrote on your tables that the afternoon was not yours. You copied the pause you had already marked. You noted the watchet at fifty shillings unpaid, and you set down no tally.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the three notes and stayed in the room.

assets.name: Love's Labour's Lost
assets.disposition: Stayed at the lodging while The Shrew was played
